title: Data of a runtime event (TELEMETRY.md section 3)

max.description: the longest main-loop pass since the previous runtime event, ms; 0 before two passes

boot.description: present, and true, only on the boot event

heap_low.description: the low-memory state the Companion's display shows (HeapFloor); absent where the build does not check the heap floor

description: Two shapes. A snapshot (periodic, and at once when a subscription starts) has reset_reason, abnormal_reset, boot_ms, loop_gap_ms and, on the Companion, heap_low. The boot event is sent once per epoch right after the first snapshot: boot is true and it carries firmware, upstream, hardware and role as hello does, and reset_reason; it has none of the snapshot-only members.
